args.title: Fix localhost URL in src/notifications/templates.ts
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email constructs its link using BASE_URL, which falls back to localhost when PUBLIC_URL is unset. We should use the configured application URL or config setting instead of hardcoding localhost.
